# Read data

```{r}
# Read and make data long so that I can for loop through all categories
west <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/marine-litter/main/data/west_coast_litter.csv") |>
  mutate(year_f = as.factor(year),
         quarter_f = as.factor(quarter),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(depth)) / sd(depth)) |>
  pivot_longer(c("fishery_a", "fishery_b", "plast_a", "plast_b", "sup_a", "sup_b", "tot_a", "tot_b"),
               names_to = "litter_category", values_to = "density")

east <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/marine-litter/main/data/east_coast_litter.csv") |>
  mutate(year_f = as.factor(year),
         quarter_f = as.factor(quarter),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(depth)) / sd(depth)) |>
  pivot_longer(c("fishery_a", "fishery_b", "plast_a", "plast_b", "sup_a", "sup_b", "tot_a", "tot_b"),
               names_to = "litter_category", values_to = "density")

# Read prediction grid so that we can scale with data to go from total biomass to biomass density
pred_grid_west <- read_csv("data/pred_grid_west.csv") |> 
  mutate(year_f = as.factor(year),
         quarter_f = as.factor(1),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(west$depth)) / sd(west$depth)) |> 
  mutate(X = X,
         Y = Y) |> 
  drop_na(area)

pred_grid_east <- read_csv("data/pred_grid_east.csv") |> 
  mutate(year_f = as.factor(year),
         quarter_f = as.factor(1),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(west$depth)) / sd(west$depth)) |> 
  mutate(X = X,
         Y = Y)

ncells_west <- filter(pred_grid_west, year == max(pred_grid_west$year)) |> nrow()
ncells_east <- filter(pred_grid_east, year == max(pred_grid_east$year)) |> nrow()
```

Read csv files with predictions, sims and coefficients

```{r}
# West
sim_west <- read_csv("output/west_dat_sim.csv") |> 
  separate(model, sep = "_", into = c("Area", "Category", "Unit")) |> 
  mutate(Category = str_to_title(Category),
         Unit = str_to_title(Unit),
         Area = str_to_title(Area),
         est = est/(ncells_west * 2*2),
         lwr = lwr/(ncells_west * 2*2),
         upr = upr/(ncells_west * 2*2),
         Category = ifelse(Category == "Fishery", "Fiske", Category),
         Unit = ifelse(Unit == "A", "Antal", "Vikt"),
         time_period = ifelse(year < 2016, "2013-2015", "2016-2021"))


# East
sim_east <- read_csv("output/east_dat_sim.csv") |> 
  separate(model, sep = "_", into = c("Area", "Category", "Unit")) |> 
  mutate(Category = str_to_title(Category),
         Unit = str_to_title(Unit),
         Area = str_to_title(Area),
         est = est/(ncells_east * 2*2),
         lwr = lwr/(ncells_east * 2*2),
         upr = upr/(ncells_east * 2*2),
         Category = ifelse(Category == "Fishery", "Fiske", Category),
         Unit = ifelse(Unit == "A", "Antal", "Vikt"),
         time_period = ifelse(year < 2016, "2013-2015", "2016-2021"))
```

pal <- brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "Paired")

## Time trends

```{r east coast plots}
pal <- brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "Dark2")

# Fit straight lines to time trends
mid_year <- 2018
sims <- bind_rows(sim_east, sim_west) |> 
  dplyr::select(-time_period) |> 
  rename(est_y = est,
         lwr_y = lwr,
         upr_y = upr,
         log_est_y = log_est, 
         se_y = se)

sims <- sims |> 
  mutate(year_ct = year - mid_year,
         id = paste(Area, Category, Unit, sep = "_"))

nd <- tibble(year = seq(min(sim_east$year), max(sim_east$year), length.out = 30)) |> 
  mutate(year_ct = year - mid_year)

trends <- list()

for(i in unique(sims$id)){
  
  dd <- filter(sims, id == i)
  
  m <- sdmTMB(est_y ~ year_ct,
              #family = Gamma(link = "log"),
              spatial = "off", 
              data = dd)
  
  m2 <- sdmTMB(est_y ~ year_ct,
               #family = Gamma(link = "log"),
               spatial = "off", 
               data = dd |> filter(year >= 2019))
  
  p <- predict(m, newdata = nd, se_fit = TRUE) |> 
    mutate(upr = est + 1.96*est_se,
           lwr = est - 1.96*est_se,
           tp = "2013-2024",
           sig = ifelse((tidy(m)$conf.low[2] > 0 & tidy(m)$conf.high[2] > 0) | (tidy(m)$conf.low[2] < 0 & tidy(m)$conf.high[2] < 0),
                        "J", "N"))
  
  p2 <- predict(m2, newdata = nd |> filter(year >= 2019), se_fit = TRUE) |> 
    mutate(upr = est + 1.96*est_se,
           lwr = est - 1.96*est_se,
           tp = "2019-2024",
           sig = ifelse((tidy(m2)$conf.low[2] > 0 & tidy(m2)$conf.high[2] > 0) | (tidy(m2)$conf.low[2] < 0 & tidy(m2)$conf.high[2] < 0),
                        "J", "N"))
  
  pp <- bind_rows(p, p2) |> 
    mutate(id = i)
    
  trends[[i]] <- pp
  
}

trends_df <- bind_rows(trends) |> 
  separate(id, into = c("Area", "Category", "Unit"), remove = FALSE)


# Loop through and plot

sims$id <- paste(sims$Area, sims$Unit, sep = "_")
trends_df$id <- paste(trends_df$Area, trends_df$Unit, sep = "_")

for(i in unique(sims$id)){
  
  dd <- sims |> filter(id == i)
  dt <- trends_df |> filter(id == i)
  
  if(unique(dd$Unit) == "Antal"){
  
    y <- bquote('Antal/'~km^2)  
    
  }  else {
    
    y <- bquote('Kg/'~km^2)  
    
  }
  
  ggplot(data = dd, aes(year, est_y)) +
    facet_wrap(~Category, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    geom_ribbon(data = dt, aes(year, est, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr,
                               color = tp, fill = tp, linetype = sig),
                alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    geom_line(data = dt, aes(year, est, color = tp, linetype = sig),
              linewidth = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr_y, ymax = upr_y), alpha = 0.4, width = 0) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = pal[c(2, 3)]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal[c(2, 3)]) + 
    ggsidekick::theme_sleek() +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.4, 0.4, 0.4), "cm"),
          legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(y = y,
         x = 'År',
         color = "Tidsperiod",
         linetype = "Signifikant") +
    NULL
  
  ggsave(paste0("figures/", i, ".png"), units = "cm", width = 20, height = 20)
  
}

```
